diagnosis: The custom Spring Boot Actuator endpoint exposes decrypted database credentials, webhook secrets, and RSA private signing keys for any tenantSlug passed as a path selector. Because the endpoint only requires general actuator role membership without evaluating whether the operator is a superadmin or belongs to the target tenant, any user with basic actuator read access can steal secrets of other tenants.
